name: agent-teams
title: Agent Teams
description: Manage local cicy-code teams from the Team Helper pane. Subcommands wrap window.cicy.localTeams.* IPCs (list/add/remove/update/upgrade/open) so the agent doesn't hand-roll JS.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: 团队管理
zh-CN.description: 在团队小助手 (w-6002) opencode pane 中管理本机 cicy-code 团队：list / add / remove / update / upgrade / open，子命令包装 window.cicy.localTeams.* IPC。

tools.name: list
tools.description: List local teams with status + version

tools.name: add
tools.example: agent-teams add --name 本地团队 --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8008 --token cicy_xxx
tools.description: Register a new local team (dedupes by base_url — same URL upserts the token)

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Download newest cicy-code binary, swap symlink, restart daemon
